stated_criteria.valid_behavior: write the input followed by a single LF to stdout; exit 0
stated_criteria.forbidden_behavior: any write past buf[31], including the terminating NUL
stated_criteria.invalid_response: write exactly the bytes of invalid_stderr to fd 2; exit 1; write nothing to stdout; do not crash

allowed_edits.redirect: one 5-byte relative call at the strcpy call site
allowed_edits.added_code: at most 256 bytes in the existing R-X segment verified-unused tail
allowed_edits.added_data: at most 64 bytes in the same R-X segment, RIP-relative references only
forbidden: new dynamic import or PLT/GOT entry
change to the entry point or the original function return value on the valid path

environment_assumptions: guest runs with no network and no credentials

diagnostic_hypothesis.statement: handle copies argv[1] into a 32-byte stack buffer with an unbounded strcpy, so inputs of 32 bytes or more overwrite the saved frame
diagnostic_hypothesis.note: A hypothesis, not an acceptance criterion.
